title: Drop the debt; put support under local control
answer: In this simulation, Parliament should remove the £10,000 charge described in s1. Support while a claim is decided should not become a bill for gaining refugee status. Councils should fund local support groups steered jointly by refugees using the service and other local residents. Those groups should choose providers and publish spending, with no provider voting on its own contract. Central government should guarantee money for food and shelter, while residents steer delivery. Judge success after a year: lower costs per person, fewer people losing shelter, and no repayment debts from support received while waiting.
